bullets.text: The Velachery Flyover project is in limbo after CMRL concluded integration was not feasible and allowed the Corporation to proceed.
Residents in Thiruvanmiyur live in severe fear as TNHB apartment buildings from 1990 are in a highly dilapidated and dangerous condition.
Relatives in Kottakuppam near Pazhaverkadu carried a dead body by boat due to a lack of road access despite years of appeals.

Birders recorded multiple white wagtails early in the migratory season at Pallikaranai for the first time in fifteen years.

The collector instructed officials to maintain social justice student hostels cleanly during a visit in Tiruttani.
Villagers complained to the Ponneri Tahsildar that a private rice mill operating around the clock in Nerkundram is severely harming public health.
Declining student interest in mathematics and the closure of 29 government colleges could hamper Tamil Nadu's artificial intelligence growth.
Experts noted that integrating Tamil knowledge into AI platforms faces challenges similar to those encountered in Tamil computing twenty-five years ago.
Chennai introduced dedicated, air-conditioned rest lounges for gig workers to improve working conditions and support delivery partners.
BJP Tamil Nadu president Nainar Nagendran accused individuals of corruption involving books written and sold using artificial intelligence technology.
